messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional seed library: borrowers may take two packets, record the variety, and return seeds after harvest only if they can verify the variety. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: Welcome to the Seed Library! Borrowers may take up to two packets of seeds per visit. Please record your selected variety on our checkout sheet before leaving. After harvest, you are welcome to return saved seeds to help our collection grow, but only if you can reliably verify the plant variety. Thank you for keeping our seed library pure and sustainable!
